thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert → service=INFERENCE-GATEWAY-USW2 ; severity=critical ; symptom=HTTP 5xx rate spike (threshold 5% over 2m). Triggered at 14:12 UTC. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345 :rotating_light:

kevin-oncall: Acked. I'm on call, starting triage.

maria-sre: quick glance at dashboards — spike localized to /v1/generate in us-west2. Error mix 502/504, p95 latency up. No obvious infra deploy in last hour.

kevin-oncall: any recent config or capacity changes? saw a warmup job finish ~10m ago.

sara.eng: confirmed warmup burst + batcher backlog. pulling logs for the last 2m. snippet:
```
[2024-04-05T14:12:03Z] host=gw-usw2-12 path=/v1/generate status=502 upstream=kvsync latency=1.2s
[2024-04-05T14:12:08Z] host=gw-usw2-07 path=/v1/generate status=504 upstream=model-node-3 latency=4.1s
```

jamie.ops: immediate mitigation idea: shed weight from the affected host and reduce warmup pool size so we don't flood new nodes. can someone adjust route weights?

kevin-oncall: doing a soft reweight on gw-usw2-07 -> 0.2 (others absorb). running:
```
redwood route adjust --service inference-gateway --host gw-usw2-07 --weight 0.2 --reason "5xx spike mitig"
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: kevin-oncall acknowledged at 1712346795.

sara.eng: also enabling fallback to quantized model variant to reduce stress on model-nodes:
```
redwood runtime set-fallback --service inference --variant quantized-v2 --enable=true
```

maria-sre: monitoring — 5xx rate dropping from 6.8% → 1.6% over the last 3m. p95 latency decreasing.

kevin-oncall: good. initial customer-impact estimate: ~120k reqs in window, ~1.2% of total returned 5xx at peak. no high-severity customer reports so far. posting to #support to watch.

support-bot: created ticket SUPPORT-INC-2024-345 and pinged on-call success lead.

jamie.ops: next steps: owner for postmortem = maria-sre. action items: (1) investigate warmup job throttling/IO, (2) review routing weight heuristics for warm hosts, (3) add thresholded auto-shed rule.

kevin-oncall: handing off to maria for follow-up. I'll stay available for 30m.

maria-sre: acknowledging handoff. will assemble timeline + add correlating logs.

incident-bot: Alert status: mitigated. Incident closed at 1712346858. Summary: route reweight + fallback variant reduced 5xxs; follow-up assigned to maria-sre. :white_check_mark:
